payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 11:9–15 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the LORD names Solomon’s covenant disobedience and announces that the kingdom will be torn and given to a servant. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
